questionBankReadiness.note: 16 questions carry Gate 25 structured ICH E6(R3) section provenance; of those, 13 additionally carry a mapped Learning Objective (the full DIRECT_GCP/CASE_APPLICATION provenance chain required by this gate). 2 legacy pre-Gate-22 UNCLASSIFIED questions have neither. No LO was invented for any question - this is a disclosed, pre-existing content-completeness gap, not fabricated.

endToEndPilotTransaction.method: real HTTP over an ephemeral NestJS server, real signed JWTs, no direct DB status writes, no seeding of questions directly into the exam

real enrollment -> real lesson completion -> examEligible=true
real ExamAttempt (start -> get questions -> submit answers -> result)
real Certificate (issue -> list -> get -> public verify)

realDefectFoundAndFixed.description: Updating any field on a question whose latest version was not DRAFT created a new version that silently dropped sourceSectionRefId and questionGenerationType, because QuestionsService.update's internal 'fields' object never included either - discovered when the first pilot-blueprint activation reported 0 eligible questions for every rule after 16 real questions were re-targeted to the pilot level.
realDefectFoundAndFixed.fix: Added sourceSectionRefId/questionGenerationType to UpdateQuestionDto (mirroring CreateQuestionDto, which already exposed both) and to the fields object using the same dto-falls-back-to-latest pattern already used for every other field.
realDefectFoundAndFixed.residualDataArtifact: The defect's first, uncaught run left 12 superseded (non-current) QuestionVersion rows with the dropped fields still null. These rows are never selected by any product logic (only the current version matters for exam eligibility/scoring), but one pre-existing regression test (case-study-generation-real-data.e2e-spec.ts) checks every historically case-study-linked version and failed on them.
realDefectFoundAndFixed.residualArtifactResolution: Repaired via a direct, targeted Prisma correction of the 2 known-correct scalar columns on those 12 specific non-current rows (no review-status/content/governance state touched), explicitly approved by the user after Claude Code's auto-mode classifier blocked the first attempt as a direct shared-resource write. Re-ran the affected test and the full e2e suite afterward - both fully green.

dataIntegrity.directDbWritesOutsideGovernedEndpoints: 1 user-approved, minimal-scope repair of 12 non-current QuestionVersion rows' sourceSectionRefId/questionGenerationType columns (bug remediation, not a governance/status change)

regression.classification: 1 real product defect found and fixed this gate (see realDefectFoundAndFixed); all other pre-existing failures observed transiently during individual runs were expected negative-path test assertions (simulated provider errors, intentionally invalid fixtures), not regressions

finalCriteria.everyPublishedQuestionHasValidIchProvena: FAIL (13/18 have complete DIRECT_GCP/CASE_APPLICATION provenance including a mapped LO; 5/18 do not)

blockingActions: Publish 2 more genuinely governed, human-approved questions with complete ICH E6(R3) provenance (SourceSection + Learning Objective) to reach the 20-question minimum - blocked externally by Gemini quota exhaustion, not by any code or process defect.

Map a Learning Objective for the 3 real DIRECT_GCP questions that currently have a valid SourceSection but no LO (GCP-Q-001181, GCP-Q-002349, GCP-Q-002350), or exclude them from the pilot-eligible pool and re-validate the blueprint against the remaining 13.
Resolve the Gemini quota exhaustion with the API provider account (QUOTA_VERIFICATION_REQUIRES_EXTERNAL_PROVIDER_ACCOUNT_ACTION) before attempting further real-AI generation.
closingStatement: NOT_PILOT_READY. Engineering gates are not yet closed - two concrete, non-speculative blocking actions remain (question-bank count and LO-mapping completeness), both bounded and externally/content-caused rather than architectural. Everything else this gate set out to prove - the real blueprint/exam/attempt/scoring/certificate chain, governance discipline, security, and regression - is genuinely proven and green.
